label: Clear action
description: Stores action zero and clears the current target, activity, destination and going-to reference. This does not assign a new job.

label: Find and perform work
description: VillagerDecide enables work pathing and calls PickWorkIfIdle. PickWork itself assigns this mode for wheat, apples and milking. SetAction does not immediately start a path for this mode.

label: Work or train at target
description: Starts a path only if MatchesWorkerSex or HasWorkplaceClass accepts the target; otherwise resets action to zero. Arrival can train a resident or assign a workplace, depending on the building and resident type.

label: Meet spouse for reproduction
description: Approaches the action target. Reproduction requires the hut-arrival checks and a spouse at that hut; the number alone does not create a child.

label: Visit or use target
description: Approaches the target using GoToObject with mode1. Arrival runs the target-class service/use logic; this is not a guaranteed purchase.

label: Claim cow
description: Approaches the target. Cow arrival, unless already following or being milked, changes ownership, stores the resident as work_object and sets cow activity90.

label: Construct or reload
description: Approaches the target and requests construction job5. Arrival at work points starts construction; arrival at a bolt trap reloads it.

label: Consume target
description: Cursor command40 chooses this mode for mushrooms and potions. Uses the common target-class arrival branch; mushroom and potion effects do not require a separate action8 comparison.

label: Pick up or activate target
description: Cursor command41 chooses this mode for portable items and interactable objects, including a lever and fountain of youth. Uses their target-class arrival logic.

label: Release following cow
description: Approaches the target. Cow arrival clears following activity90 and its work_object reference; other cow modes are not released by this branch.

label: Attend wedding
description: Church/hut arrivals drive the wedding sequence. ContinueAction clears this action and sends the resident home if the spouse is absent or the resident is no longer moving.

label: Heal resident
description: Approaches a target resident; arrival starts healing activity13 and stores the patient as work_object. Building repair is a different action.

label: Preach to resident
description: Approaches a target resident; arrival increases that resident law by a random32..63 and clears the action.

label: Repair building
description: Approaches the target and requests maintenance job23. Arrival starts activity116 only when the target is the building the worker has entered, then clears the action.

label: Demolish building
description: Approaches the target. Arrival starts activity117 only when the target is the building the worker has entered, then clears the action.

label: Force attack on target
description: GoToObject uses mode0 rather than mode1. Arrival sets the forced-attack flag for units supporting military job26; otherwise clears action and stores the attack target without that branch flag.

label: Arrest resident
description: Approaches the target. Arrival completes the arrest only for a guard: freezes/stops the prisoner, clears jobs and carries the prisoner. Other unit types clear the action.
